# curl_reap

> One Python library for getting past TLS fingerprinting, surviving markup changes, and crawling at scale.

Canonical page: https://anishfyi.com/curl_reap/
Source: https://github.com/anishfyi/curl_reap
Install: pip install curl_reap
Version at time of writing: 0.3.0
Author: Anish Kr Singh (anishfyi), https://anishfyi.com/

## What it is

curl_reap combines browser-grade TLS and JA3 impersonation, self-healing CSS and XPath selectors, one-call structured extraction and a concurrent crawl engine in a single Python library.

## Facts

- Sends a real Chrome or Safari TLS and JA3 fingerprint through curl_cffi, so sites that block stock Python clients with a 403 serve the page.
- Self-healing CSS and XPath selectors re-find an element after a site renames a class.
- One-call structured extraction to JSON-LD, tables and markdown.
- Includes disk caching, retries and a hand-written concurrent crawl engine.
- Collapses three tools into one: curl_cffi for the handshake, Scrapling for healing selectors, Scrapy for the crawl.
- MIT licensed, current version 0.3.0, published to PyPI as `curl-reap`.
- Sponsored by NodeMaven, a disclosed commercial relationship.

## Questions and answers

### What is curl_reap?

curl_reap is a Python scraping library that combines browser-grade TLS impersonation, self-healing selectors, structured extraction and a concurrent crawl engine behind one API.

### Why does my scraper get a 403 when the browser loads the page fine?

Most sites fingerprint the TLS handshake, not just the user agent. Python's default HTTP stack has a distinctive JA3 fingerprint that anti-bot services recognise. curl_reap sends a real Chrome or Safari fingerprint via curl_cffi, so the handshake looks like a browser and the page loads.

### How do I install curl_reap?

Run `pip install curl_reap`. On PyPI the distribution name is `curl-reap`.

### What are self-healing selectors?

A plain CSS or XPath selector breaks the moment a site renames a class. Self-healing selectors record enough about the element that curl_reap can re-find it after the markup changes, so the scraper keeps working.

### How does curl_reap compare to Scrapy, Scrapling and curl_cffi?

curl_cffi gives you the browser TLS handshake but no parser. Scrapy gives you the crawl engine but no fingerprint impersonation. Scrapling gives you healing selectors. curl_reap provides all three plus structured extraction in one library.

### Can curl_reap crawl many pages at once?

Yes. It ships a hand-written concurrent crawl engine with throttling, retries, dedup and disk caching.
